Name: Wands of The Harry Potter Wizarding World
Author: sexynes
Description:
To acquire a wand, one must somehow obtain it from the travelling cart. 

Warning: it seems the wands are currently on the avada kedavra setting. I would recommend waiting for an update before relying on these instruments, though it may take months as I am working on other mods.

Mod is subject to changes to keep wands balanced and appealing. 

If anyone is ambitious to expand wandlore in Stardew Valley, learn how to mod, or improve this mod in any way, we can collaborate to make your ambitions a reality. It took considerable work to make all 47 of these wands and any additional help would be appreciated. 

While making this mod, I was thinking it would be nice to see a Hogwarts expansion mod in the future. If others are equally ambitious, we can work together to create such a mod.
